name: Sessy
description: Email observability platform for monitoring and analyzing email systems.
composeYaml:
services:
  sessy:
    image: 'ghcr.io/marckohlbrugge/sessy:main'
    environment:
      - SECRET_KEY_BASE=${SESSYSECRET}
      - HTTP_AUTH_USERNAME=${SESSY_USER}
      - HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD=${SESSY_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - 'sessy-data:/rails/storage'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:80 || [ $? -eq 22 ]'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
